acceptance: One reader decodes state.json lastCycleNumber; redteamcheck and wave call it, and a test pins the absent-file and malformed-file results.
The wave facts list a squash-merged PR: a test with a first-parent subject 'feat: x (#123)' lists #123.
fix: (1) Give one package a read-only reader for state.json lastCycleNumber (next to cyclestate.State), and make redteamcheck and wave use it. (2) Read the merged PRs of a boundary from a source that also covers a squash merge: the PR number in the commit subject '(#N)' on first-parent commits, or the pr merge verb's own record.
root_cause: The wave lane (cl-wave-cli, 2026-10-08) added a small decoder to stay out of the state.json read-modify-write path, and read merges from git subjects because no PR-number record exists for a squash merge.
summary: Two ad-hoc decoders read state.json lastCycleNumber beside the typed cyclestate.State: internal/redteamcheck/redteamcheck.go and internal/wave/facts.go (LastCycleNumber). Also, evolve wave next lists the PRs merged at a boundary from 'Merge pull request #N' subjects of git log --first-parent --merges, so a squash merge or a rebase merge is not counted in the wave facts.
title: evolve wave: read state.json lastCycleNumber through one shared reader, and count squash-merged PRs in the wave facts
